intent_contract.text: 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
Test high-jewelry craft through matched gemstone layout, visible setting contacts, supporting metal gallery, and an original integrated design inside an unrelated deep-sea science environment.

Create a photorealistic high-craft editorial of an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and precise concentration. At a compact jewelry bench inside a pressurized deep-sea submersible laboratory, she places the final matched blue-green gemstone into an original tidal-navigation brooch beneath a binocular microscope. The stones form a deliberate graduated sequence matched by size and color. Visible prongs, a partial bezel, and tiny pave beads physically secure the stones to a platinum-toned supporting gallery, and the same original spiral-wave geometry connects stone layout and metal structure. Compose her recognizable face, steady hands, loupe, ordered layout tray, and enlarged brooch work point in one medium-close frame. Controlled specular highlights reveal each setting contact while soft bioluminescent ocean light and warm bench illumination separate gemstone, polished edge, brushed plane, and structural depth.
